final: WITH g AS (SELECT ArtistId AS aid, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Album GROUP BY ArtistId), s AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM g), p AS (SELECT g.aid, g.cnt, CAST(g.cnt AS REAL)/s.total AS share FROM g JOIN s ON s.total IS NOT NULL), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM p) SELECT p.aid, p.cnt, p.share, p.share - a.avg_share AS diff FROM p JOIN a ON a.avg_share IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
